tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /drang srong dri med kyi brgyud rim gsol 'debs bzhugs so//

gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 'chang*// de dang dbyer med drang srong dri ma med// rā dza'i tshul 'dzin dharma a sho kar| |gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs// sgrub la mnga' brnyes bram ze legs grub dang*// khyu mchog chen po slob dpon pra ha sti// o rgyan yul byon padma rgyal po la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs// mnga' bdag nyang dang nyang sras blo ldan zhabs| |gu rus byin brlabs gu ru chos kyi dbang*// sras kyi mchog gyur padma dbang rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs| |yar ston sangs rgyas gnyen ston bkra shis seng*// chos nyid rang grol sangs rgyas lhun grub dbang*// kun dga' bkra shis rgyal sras chos rje la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs// chos 'phags bzang po shākya dpal bzang dang*// 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i zhabs// hūm̐ kar rnam sbrul gnam lcags me 'bar la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje bdud 'joms mchog grub rgyal po dang*// grags pa rgyal mtshan dkon mchog rin chen sogs// dri med grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol 'debs bu la byin chen phob// lus la rdo rje sku yi byin chen phob// ngag la rdo rje sngags kyi byin chen phob// yid la rdo rje ting 'dzin byin chen phob// mchog thun dngos grub byin chen myur du phob// 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i byin chen phob// mthu rtsal nus pa ldan pa'i byin chen phob// sde brgyad dbang du 'du ba'i byin chen phob// don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa'i byin chen phob// ces pa'ang rjes gnang gi skabs su byin 'bebs dang*/ 'phral du gsol 'debs su rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas rang lo bcu gcig gi thog tu drang srong nyid sgrub pa'i skabs su bgyis pa dge'o//
